selection: Seeded draw: one log from a repository of every language, further repositories to reach 40, then second logs from those repositories to reach 60. Logs with a repeated chunk, over 600,000 bytes or over 15,000 lines, or with a chunk over 200 lines, were not drawn. Every other log is held out.
